title: Board tag profile (shared plumbing)
body: Compute once per scan: tag counts over MY picks, TEAMMATES' picks, ENEMY picks (the other five rows) and the UNPICKED pool. Passed to the scorer like the scarcity map. Every new verdict below reads from it. Enemy/team-aware boosts are board facts, so they join the role-independent set (Aghs stacking, overrated damp, point-sink) and apply with role mode off; golden tests zero the new terms.

title: Split into reposition_enemy + reposition_ally
body: THREE tags now. reposition_enemy = pulls / throws / swaps / long pushes that change where the fight happens. reposition_ally = moves an ally to safety. knockback = a short displacement whose value is the interrupt (stops Charge, Blast Off, Skewer) and the spacing, not the catch. Black Hole, Bushwhack, Tornado, Arena, Electric Vortex, Ice Vortex, Wheel of Wonder and Fiend's Gate carry none of the three. move_enemy stays a rename alias to reposition_enemy in the import script.

title: reposition_enemy scoring: a pos-4 'catch' need + pos-3 initiation alternative
body: New need key catch for position 4 (priority 0.5, own scarcity key: a pool with one Hook and no stuns rates it like the last stun does today). Full-credit alternative for the pos-3 initiation need. The catch need STACKS with the hard_cc need when an ability carries both, which is the 'breaks formation, stronger than plain CC' premium. Role layer only, role-off invariant untouched.

title: reposition_ally scoring: covers the pos-5 save need + pos-4/5 accent
body: Full-credit alternative for the pos-5 save need (chip: covers: save (via reposition_ally)), plus a +ROLE_TAG_ACCENT_WEIGHT (0.05) accent for positions 4 and 5 as the 'brings them to safety, stronger than a plain save' premium. No pos-1/2 minus accent: a swap is a fine core escape.

title: Split damage_amp into spell_steroid / amp_physical / amp_magical / amp_all
body: spell_steroid = SELF spell amp (Arcane Supremacy, Overcharge, Croak of Genius). amp_physical / amp_magical / amp_all = amps the whole team benefits from. Self-only amps that need SPECIFIC partners (Sticky Napalm, Liquid Frost) are not tagged at all: they are combo hubs and live in the combos: relation. Self-only amps on a right-click kit (Flesh Golem, Wild Axes on the BM side) stay plain steroid.

title: Team-amp demand boost (role-independent)
body: demand(physical) = steroid count over my + teammates' picks; demand(magical) = nuke + teamfight_ult count; amp_all uses both. boost = AMP_TEAM_WEIGHT (0.06, the Aghs figure) x clamp(demand / 3, 0, 1). Zero demand = zero boost (a Gush on a caster team stays a slow). Teammates DO count here, unlike Aghs stacking: the amp lands on the enemy and everyone benefits. Tooltip names the picks it amplifies.

title: spell_steroid: pos-2 nuke alternative, gated on owning a nuke
body: spell_steroid is a plus accent for position 2 and counts as a full-credit alternative for the pos-2 nuke need ONLY when the drafter already owns a nuke (soft gate, same shape as the Aghs own-pick gate). Not a requires hard gate: Arcane Supremacy is picked 4.6th on average, a hard gate would hide a top-10 pick.

title: Team amps get the pos-4/5 plus accent
body: amp_physical / amp_magical / amp_all are farm-free team actives, the same reasoning that puts team_aura on the pos-5 plus list. +ROLE_TAG_ACCENT_WEIGHT for positions 4 and 5.

title: Rename good_counter to good_deny; combo links are curated, never data-driven
body: good_deny marks 'playable on its own, so the deny is not a dead pick'. The combo links are CURATED ONLY: your partner lists overrode the synergy table in 14 of 16 carriers (Dispersion / Borrowed Time style pairs are good, not deny-worthy). The table stays a suggestion source inside the Tag Lab composer and never triggers anything in the app.

title: Deny marker + boost logic
body: For each unpicked candidate C with good_deny and a combos: list: if the ENEMY holds any listed partner (ability, or model:<hero> for the OD case), show the deny marker, tooltip 'deny: completes <partner> for row N', and add DENY_BOOST (0.05), role-independent, outside the role cap. Fires only while the enemy still has turns. No partner held by the enemy = nothing at all.

title: Not-a-dead-pick guard
body: The boost applies only when C's own global score sits above the pool median (so a 0.44-winrate ability is never pushed by a deny alone); below that, the marker still shows with the tooltip but the score is untouched. Tell me if you would rather trust the tag fully and skip the guard.

title: Visual only: distinct border + tooltip line, no score term
body: A pick_asap pool slot gets its own border treatment and a tooltip line 'Community: pick as soon as possible'. No score change. Open question: show the border unconditionally (it is the community's verdict) or only while live stats agree (winrate >= 0.52 and avg pick <= 10)? My pick: unconditional border, and the tooltip adds the live numbers so a stale verdict is visible.

title: Staleness audit at import time
body: import_site_export.py prints pick_asap carriers whose live stats fail the gate above as Tag Lab review items. Today: Forge Spirit (avg pick 17.6); Shadow Dance borderline (10.9).

title: Split dispel into dispel_self / dispel_ally / purge_enemy
body: dispel_self = removes debuffs from the caster. dispel_ally = can be cast on an ally to remove their debuffs (the save-grade one). purge_enemy = removes BUFFS from enemies (and kills illusions). Strength (basic vs strong) stays out of v1. dispel becomes a rename alias to dispel_self in the import script, with the per-ability remap below.

title: Mechanical demand tags from dotaconstants: debuff_dispellable / debuff_strong_only
body: Built by build_ability_tags.py from the dotaconstants dispellable field, no LLM, no voting, hidden from the Lab composer. Over the 513 draftables: Yes 176, No 128, Strong-only 48, unknown 161. Enemy-targeting + Yes = 70 abilities, 17 of them with no CC tag today (Wild Axes, Bramble Maze, Breathe Fire, Fade Bolt, Corrosive Haze, Fatal Bonds, Mortimer Kisses, Strafe, Life Break, Kazurai Katana...). No hand-curated dot tag needed: the scorer does not care that a debuff ticks.

title: Dispel demand boost (role-independent)
body: demand = enemy.debuff_dispellable + 0.5 x pool.debuff_dispellable. boost = DISPEL_WEIGHT (0.06) x clamp(demand / 4, 0, 1.5) on dispel_ally and dispel_self carriers; tooltip 'dispels: Corrosive Haze, Fatal Bonds (enemy)'. Zero demand = zero boost, the carriers fall back to the save_ally / sustain_self they already carry. purge_enemy demand = enemy steroid + summon + illusion counts.

title: Build order
body: 1 plumbing + mechanical debuff tags; 2 reposition split and dispel split + demand boost; 3 damage-amp split + team demand; 4 good_deny + combos: relation; 5 pick_asap border + audit. Each step is its own PR with golden fixtures.

title: knockback: descriptive only in v1
body: No scoring term and no need credit for knockback in v1. Its real value (interrupting Charge of Darkness, Blast Off, Skewer, Rolling Thunder) belongs to the counters/combos machinery later: 'knockback counters tag:charge' once a charge tag exists. Gust keeps its soft_cc value regardless. Tell me if you want a small credit now instead.

title: Gap-close stays mobility + initiation (no new tag)
body: Reality Rift, Grappling Claw, Blink Strike, Phantom Strike and friends already carry mobility + initiation, which is what the needs engine reads for a gap-closer. A dedicated gap_close tag would only split the same signal. Proposal: no new tag. Say so if you want it anyway and I will add it to the vocab round.

title: Shard / Scepter-granted effects: tagged, marked as upgrade-dependent (decided)
body: Decision: effects granted by Shard are ALWAYS tagged (cheap, a standard buy with the right abilities); Scepter-granted effects are tagged too, and both carry a viaUpgrade marker so the tooltip says 'with Shard' / 'with Scepter'. The scorer counts them at full value. Ability dependencies (Nether Strike needs Greater Bash) stay a conditional with: entry, honored only when the dependency is drafted.
